description: SQLite 'no such column: confidence' on startup
resolution: Happened because fees.db was created before citation fields were added to fee_rows. Fixed by _migrate_schema() which now runs on every Database() init. Also needed to update MockExtractor to pass source_page/source_section/footnote_refs/confidence/confidence_reason to FeeRow constructor - these are required positional args.

description: --report crashes with TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of NoneType and str
resolution: SQLite returns None for NULL columns, not missing keys, so .get('field', '') still returns None. Use x.get('field') or '' everywhere a sort key or display field touches a nullable DB column.

description: CBOE CDN returns S3 AccessDenied XML even in browser
resolution: The hardcoded PDF URL path /resources/regulation/fee_schedules/ is deprecated. New CDN path includes year and effective date in filename - it changes every update. Switched to CSV endpoint which is stable. See exchanges domain for full detail.

description: Windows console UnicodeEncodeError on box-drawing chars
resolution: Windows PowerShell console (cp1252) cannot encode Unicode box-drawing chars like U+2500 (─) U+2550 (═). Use plain ASCII - and = everywhere in print() output. Use PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 env var as a workaround if needed but prefer ASCII in source.
